source_image: image/บ้าน_เล็ก_1ชั้น_13/บ้าน_เล็ก_1ชั้น_13_หน้า29.png
warnings: Zone 3 genuinely upsizes the pedestal/footing column cross-section and rebar versus both the normal table (S-05: 0.20x0.20m, 4-Ø12mm) and the zone-1&2 table (S-10: 0.20x0.20m, 4-Ø12mm) — here it is 0.25x0.25m, 4-Ø16mm for BOTH C0 and C1 at ตอม่อ/ฐานราก level. This is a real, confirmed difference (re-verified at high zoom against S-10's identical-looking table to rule out a misread), not a transcription slip.

C1's ระดับอะเส/ระดับพื้นชั้น 1 box, by contrast, stays at the smaller 0.20x0.20m cross-section with 4-Ø16mm (bar size upsized from S-10's 4-Ø12mm, but the concrete section size unchanged) and stirrup spacing '@VARIES' — detailed on this sheet's column-rebar-spacing drawing below the table.

This sheet's own notes (companion file _view2_notes_seismic3.json) additionally require widening beams B1 and RB1 to 0.15x0.40m for zone 3 construction — a requirement not present on S-10 (zones 1 and 2).
